question.prompt: Use 24 m of fencing to enclose a rectangle against a sufficiently long wall (fence only three sides, with the wall forming the fourth side). What is the maximum area? (Unit: \(\mathrm{m}^2\))

solutions.explanation: Let the side perpendicular to the wall have length \(x\). Then the side parallel to the wall has length \(24-2x\), and \(S=x(24-2x)=-2(x-6)^2+72\). The maximum is 72 when \(x=6\).
solutions.title: Model three fenced sides
